| Empty | The proceeds list is empty for the case; no match is recorded and no posting starts |
| Error | The proceeds list cannot be read; the error is shown and no match is recorded |
| No access | The caller's role does not include the write-off and posting right, or the case is outside their scope; the proceeds are not shown and no match is recorded (MSG-P4-002) |
